<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="wxsky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0a1524"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#0a1018"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#05070c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="wxsweep" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#35e0d6" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#35e0d6" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#wxsky)"/>

  <!-- scanlines -->
  <g stroke="#0f2030" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35">
    <line x1="0" y1="60" x2="640" y2="60"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="120" x2="640" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="640" y2="180"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="240" x2="640" y2="240"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="300" x2="640" y2="300"/>
  </g>

  <!-- radar dish, upper-right -->
  <g transform="translate(500,110)">
    <circle r="78" fill="#07131c" stroke="#173444" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle r="52" fill="none" stroke="#173444" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle r="26" fill="none" stroke="#173444" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="-78" y1="0" x2="78" y2="0" stroke="#173444" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="-78" x2="0" y2="78" stroke="#173444" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <path d="M0 0 L78 0 A78 78 0 0 0 55 -55 Z" fill="url(#wxsweep)"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="34" cy="-20" r="3" fill="#f5a623"/>
    <circle cx="-40" cy="14" r="2.5" fill="#ff4a4a"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="46" r="2" fill="#35e0d6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- lightning bolt accent, lower-left -->
  <path d="M120 208 L96 262 L118 262 L100 316 L156 250 L132 250 L152 208 Z"
        fill="#f5a623" opacity="0.92"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="40" y="150" fill="#eaf4f8" font-size="76" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="4">DOOMCAST</text>
  <rect x="42" y="168" width="300" height="3" fill="#35e0d6"/>
  <text x="44" y="196" fill="#35e0d6" font-size="19" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="6">WX-9 · METEOWATCH</text>

  <!-- footer band -->
  <rect x="0" y="322" width="640" height="38" fill="#0c1a24"/>
  <rect x="0" y="322" width="640" height="2" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <text x="20" y="347" fill="#9fb8c4" font-size="15" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="3">SEVEN-DAY OUTLOOK</text>
  <text x="620" y="347" fill="#eaf4f8" font-size="15" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="2" text-anchor="end">with DOPPLER DEX RIME</text>
</svg>
name: wx_doomcast_title
